sources.title: Realbotix Renames Echo as Series 1: $5,975 Invoice Before Build, Cloud ...
sources.snippet: Realbotix Series 1 is the new name for Echo humanoid robots, but the terms are unchanged: a $199 deposit, a 50% invoice ($5,975 for the Tabletop) before building, and a monthly AI plan from $19.99.
